decisionTitle: Keep physical page framing separate from logical receive credit
decision: The native group writes one receipt and all covered updates in the same existing atomic append, with its witness counting those actual heads writes. Per-position credit remains logical. Keep the own-stream conformance guard; obtain actual dense native proof through the composed peer/Worker path, never by weakening that guard. A local import alias keeps existing fault controls byte-exact.
